items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We were the . . . the rhthym section of Bebo Valdés’ Orquesta Ritmo de Batanga.

ctx.x: Yes, it was the combination of the conga and bata drums and very good arrangements. It began in 1952 on radio Cadena Azul. The rhythm Batanga. And Bebo was the composer and creator and the contributors were Trinidad Torregrosa who played the Iyá batá drum, Rolando Alfonso, Jesus and me. We were the . . . the rhthym section of Bebo Valdés’ Orquesta Ritmo de Batanga.
And what kind of popularity did the Batanga have?
